## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the
      [Engineering Standards](../spec/ion_spec/ENGINEERING_STANDARDS.md).
- [ ] `make ci` passes locally.
- [ ] I added tests that exercise real code paths (no stubs/mocks/fakes except at
      true external boundaries).
- [ ] I updated documentation as needed.
- [ ] I updated `spec/ion_spec/spec.kvx` if requirements changed.
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] No emojis, purple gradients, or glow effects in UI or output.
- [ ] UI separation uses background-color contrast, not border strokes.
